env.sandboxHint: Sees only its own work directory and the project's package cache, not other AI teammates' work
env.selfHostedHint: For when it must be a particular computer: runs directly on it, without isolation, and can see and operate the whole computer
env.noDeviceOfMine: You have no devices you can choose; only their team administrators can choose one
env.ownerOnly: Only the device's team administrators can choose it
env.sessionHint: Changes only this AI teammate; the others are not affected. It first pushes its changes to its branch, and changes either way; the changes as of each time it stops are kept in a snapshot.
env.notStarted: Not started yet; it will use the default for new AI teammates
env.defaultHint: Only affects AI teammates that start from now on; those already running keep their own environment.

usage.partlyUnpriced: Another {tokens} tokens have no rate and are not in the amount
usage.allUnpriced: {tokens} tokens have no rate, so no amount is shown here
